title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date headline run across North America scheduled for spring 2027, her first full itinerary there since 2025.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date headline run across North America scheduled for spring 2027, her first full itinerary there since 2025. The announcement puts a sustained headline schedule back on her calendar after more than a year in which live work returned carefully rather than all at once. It is the first time since those cancellations that she has committed to a full tour rather than a smaller sequence of individual appearances and festival dates.

That pause began after Young collapsed during her set at All Things Go in New York in September 2025. A few days later, she cancelled every upcoming performance for the foreseeable future, including a North American tour that had been due to follow *I'm Only F**king Myself*. Her message at the time was unusually direct. She said she needed time to work on herself and asked fans to give her a second chance when she was ready to return. Her first substantial public update after the break sounded deliberately cautious, saying she hoped to get back to performing gradually during 2026 rather than naming a date for a full comeback.

That gradual return became visible over the following months. "Messy" won Best Pop Solo Performance at the Grammys in February, where Young also performed, and she later resumed headline shows in the UK before moving back onto festival stages. She later returned to the same festival in 2026, walking back onto a stage connected directly to the performance that had brought the previous run to an abrupt stop. The difference was not simply that she was performing again. She had spent most of 2026 testing a live schedule in pieces before committing to another long North American itinerary.

[apple:song:6768357139:6768357142]

Her music changed alongside that return. "From Down Here," released in May and made with James Blake, came from an idea Young says arrived the morning after her Grammy win. Young described the song as being about missing an old high while knowing that a more grounded life is safer and ultimately more rewarding. That tension gives the track a calmer perspective than much of the album, without sanding away the bluntness that made songs such as "Messy" connect in the first place. It also gives the next tour fresh material that belongs to the period after her break rather than to the album cycle that was interrupted by it.

The title Everything Begins comes from a reversal of Young's "Everything Ends" tattoo, but the phrase now has a fairly literal context around it. When she cancelled the 2025 dates, she did not announce a rescheduled tour or offer a timetable for returning. The months that followed were built around individual appearances, a Grammy performance, a handful of headline shows and festival sets. The 2027 run is different because it restores the kind of sustained schedule she had stepped away from. When Young cancelled the earlier dates, she offered no timetable for returning to a full tour. The new itinerary is the first time she has done that since the break.
